تحتجزون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَجِزُونَ (taḥtajizūna) /taħ.ta.d͡ʒi.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# تُحْتَجَزُونَ (tuḥtajazūna) /tuħ.ta.d͡ʒa.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
